title: Door-dispatched workers keep their log tail and carry a harness budget
description: From yoh findings 127240d6 and b21c18d0 (9iz). A door-dispatched worker's log output after the confirm window goes nowhere, and the door carries no per-worker harness budget (TICKS_WORKER_TIMEOUT), which the wave path used to set. For an unattended cloud run both matter: the tail is where a failed worker says why, and a budget is the runaway guard (liveness itself is b1t's: pi's session log, not a wall clock).
acceptance_criteria: A door-dispatched worker's whole log reaches the run's logs; the door carries a harness budget taken from config and the worker honours it; tests cover both
